logline: When Alexander returns to the cottage gravely wounded and soaked in blood, Juliana tends to his injuries, leading to an intimate confrontation where their unspoken feelings and scarred pasts finally collide.
continuity_notes: Follows the ominous revelation from Episode 9 of rumors circulating about a scarred war veteran, cutting directly to the secluded cottage where Alexander arrives bearing fresh wounds.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile shot of Juliana sitting at a wooden table beside the glowing fireplace, reading an old herbal medicine book.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana quietly studies the botanical illustrations by firelight, a bundle of fresh dried herbs resting on the table.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: A heavy wooden door suddenly creaks and bangs open in the quiet cottage.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Juliana jerks her head up from the book, startled by the sudden intrusion.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium wide shot framing the doorway as Alexander stands framed in the dark threshold, panting heavily, his hand pressed against his blood-soaked chest.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana rising swiftly from her chair, shock and terror flashing across her face.

segments.label: JULIANA (Alarmed, Breathless)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Alexander!

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander struggling to breathe, clutching his bloodied coat over his chest.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gruff, Strained)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: It is nothing.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana hurriedly stepping toward him across the stone floor.

segments.label: JULIANA (Urgent, Worried)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: There is blood running down your arm.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium profile two-shot as Alexander stands rigid while Juliana confronts him.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Stiff, Dismissive)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: A cut from the tenant fields.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide shot of the hearth room as Juliana firmly points toward a wooden armchair beside the fire.

segments.label: JULIANA (Commanding, Resolute)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Sit down.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's determined, unyielding expression.

segments.label: JULIANA (Stern)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Now.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander reluctantly lowering his heavy frame onto the chair in front of the fire.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium tracking shot following Juliana as she brings a wooden washbowl, fresh cloth, and an earthen jar of ointment to the foot of his chair.

segments.label: JULIANA (Gentle, Insistent)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: I need to see the wound.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Low-angle close-up of Alexander looking up at her stubbornly.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Defiant)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: It is only a scratch.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana crossing her arms over her chest, eyeing him with quiet defiance.

segments.label: JULIANA (Sarcastic, Challenging)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Then removing your shirt should not trouble you.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot as Alexander stares at her for a beat before pushing himself up from the chair and shedding his heavy leather coat.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana observing him with guarded anticipation.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up shot of Alexander pulling his dark shirt over his head, revealing his muscular torso crisscrossed with jagged battle scars and fresh bleeding lacerations.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight pan over the scarred, wounded flesh along his chest and ribs.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's eyes widening in horror and deep pity.

segments.label: JULIANA (Whispering, Distressed)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Dear God.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium wide shot as Alexander sinks back into the chair, exhausted, while Juliana slowly kneels before him on the stone floor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up macro shot of Juliana's trembling fingers hovering tenderly over the raised, jagged scar across Alexander's chest.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up at him, her eyes softened with profound empathy.

segments.label: JULIANA (Soft, Sorrowful)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You have suffered terribly.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander's weathered, scarred face gazing down at her with quiet stoicism.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Quiet, Somber)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: It is over.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana dipping a linen cloth into the water bowl.

segments.label: JULIANA (Gentle)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Your scars disagree.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up shot of Juliana carefully dabbing the damp cloth against the bloody cut on Alexander's shoulder.

segments.label: JULIANA (Tender)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Does it hurt?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander trying not to wince under her touch.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Gruff)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Not much.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, amused by his stubborn pride.

segments.label: JULIANA (Playful, Whispering)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: You are a terrible liar.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's fingers taking a dollop of green herbal salve and smoothing it gently over his shoulder wound.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up over Juliana's shoulder looking at Alexander, who stares intently into her face, oblivious to the wound.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up from his shoulder into his eyes, sensing the intensity of his gaze.

segments.label: JULIANA (Soft, Breathless)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Why do you look at me like that?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander, his voice deep and laden with restrained emotion.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Intense, Sincere)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Because you are looking at me.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking back down at his shoulder to hide her growing fluster, applying the salve carefully.

segments.label: JULIANA (Flustered, Whispering)
segments.speaker: JULIANA
segments.text: Hold still.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Alexander leaning closer to her, his breathing heavy.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Low, Husky)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: I am holding still.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up two-shot of their faces drawing mere inches apart in the warm firelight.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Whispering, Vulnerable)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Perhaps it is your hand.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Alexander's large, rough hands reaching up and gently enveloping Juliana's slender hands, bringing them against his bare chest over his racing heart.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up shot of Alexander gazing into Juliana's eyes with raw, unmasked devotion.

segments.label: ALEXANDER (Deep, Emotional)
segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
segments.text: Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up shot holding on Juliana's wide, luminous blue eyes, completely captivated and overwhelmed by his confession, the firelight dancing across their intertwined hands as the scene lingers and fades.
